item.title: I don’t understand why some Ocala roads are in disrepair
item.description: "I do not understand why, in a rapidly growing city like Ocala, which charges such high property taxes, etc., the roads are all in such deplorable conditions. There are potholes everywhere! Deep ones! All they do is pour tar in and they do not even smooth it out. The same erodes in no time and the holes come right back. It is like that all over Ocala!
